## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0, electron n = +3.2 / hole n = −1.2 ×10¹²

Raw first, then the read. Channel: R = (sr1_X/1)/(sr0_X/−1e6). Both runs are complete, with no rail (peak R 530/590 Ω on a 5 kΩ full scale) and T_sample at 1.17–1.29 K. Run 6's onset is read on the 10 mT (≥ 1 T) record only; its 50 mT steps below 1 T under-sample a 7 T tone.

**Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2, F_L = 33.1 T): clean, rich SdH.** The tones sit near 7.3–7.5, 14.9, 22.3 and 29.9 T. `sdh_onset` flags them as a 7.3 T harmonic comb (×2, ×3, ×4). The investigation's Luttinger-aware screen forbids taking that at face value. {7.5, 22.3} could equally be an ABAB pair summing to the 29.9 T tone at a lever-arm scale of ≈ 0.90, with the 29.9 T tone at F_L as the ABCA-singleton or ABAB-breakdown/sum-tone candidate. A single density cannot tell a comb from a pair from a singleton. A density sweep can: a harmonic tracks k·f₁ exactly, while the ABAB heavy/light ratio drifts from 3.5 at n = 3.2 to 4.8 at n = 2.0 (model). **Onsets:** the light tone is still above threshold at the 1.0 T record edge (censored, window SNR ≈ 100). On the 22.3 T tone, damping looks LK-thermal (SNR 5 → 51 over 1.27 → 3.5 T ≈ the R_T ratio at m* 0.06, T_e ≈ 8 K). Carried to m* ≈ 0.027, that puts the light tone at SNR ≈ 15 at 0.7 T. The heavy tones come in at 1.40 T (22.3 T) and 1.76 T (29.9 T).

**Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2, F_L = 12.4 T): the near-CNP exception regime.** The tones (6.6, 4.7, 8.5, 12.3 T, onset 0.71 T) overlap within δF ≈ 1.5 T. The model's ABAB hole pair (5.9 / 6.5 T) is close and balanced there, and the ABCA hole mass is ≈ 1 mₑ (LK-dead). This is a preview only, not a read. The hole side cannot reach design density (the D = 0 line is TG-limited at −1.27×10¹²).

**Call for Step 4:** the fan goes on the **electron side**, which is the cleaner side and the only one reaching |n| ≳ 2×10¹². It inherits 50 µV / τ 0.3 s / 24 dB, onsets 1.40 / 1.76 T for the heavy tones and < 1 T (censored) for the light tone. No stacking call yet.

"""Runs 6/7 — sdh-spot-check read. Raw MR first, then sdh_onset (10 mT record only) and 1/B FFTs vs F_L + the FS-count model."""
import sys, warnings
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as fsm

def rxx(rid):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I); o = np.argsort(B)
    return r, B[o], R[o]

SPOT = {6: (+3.2, 1.0), 7: (-1.2, 0.3)}      # n (1e12), low edge of the adequately sampled record (run 6: 50 mT below 1 T under-samples a 7 T tone)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
for j, (rid, (n, bmin)) in enumerate(SPOT.items()):
    r, B, R = rxx(rid)
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(n * 1e16)); ab = [f for f, _ in fsm.abab_fs(n * 1e16)[1]]
    print(f"== run {rid}: n = {n:+.1f}e12, D = 0; R {R.min():.0f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm (5 kOhm FS -> max {R.max()/5000:.0%}); "
          f"T {np.nanmin(r.col('T_sample')):.3f}-{np.nanmax(r.col('T_sample')):.3f} K; interrupted={r.interrupted}")
    print(f"   F_L = {FL:.1f} T | model ABAB {', '.join(f'{f:.1f}' for f in ab)} T (sum {sum(ab):.1f}) | ABCA {FL:.1f} T")
    s = B >= bmin
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always"); on = sdh_onset(R[s], B[s], b_lo=bmin, r_full_scale=5000)
    print("   " + on.summary().replace("\n", "\n   ")); [print("   W:", x.message) for x in w]
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, j].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} raw, n = {n:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    for br, c in [((max(bmin, 1.3), 7.4), "C0"), ((bmin, 4.0), "C1"), ((max(bmin, 1.3), 10.0), "C2")]:
        fr, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=br, bg_degree=5, nfft=4096); sp = sp[0]
        ax[1, j].plot(fr, sp / sp[fr > 1.5].max(), c, lw=0.9, label=f"B {br[0]:.1f}-{br[1]:.1f} T (dF {1/(1/br[0]-1/br[1]):.1f} T)")
    ax[1, j].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label="F_L (scale 1)"); [ax[1, j].axvline(f, color="g", ls=":", lw=1) for f in ab]
    ax[1, j].set(xlim=(0, 1.6 * FL), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm.)", title="1/B FFT, log R, poly5-in-B bg; green = model ABAB pair")
    ax[1, j].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.suptitle("vti-02 sdh-spot-checks, runs 6 (electron) / 7 (hole), D = 0, T_sample 1.17-1.29 K"); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) → per-column FFT for the stacking read

> **05:29** · Landau fan e-side: D=0, n +3.2->+2.0e12 (25 pts, dn 0.05) x B 0.70->10.0 T (92 rows, uniform 1/B: 0.030 <1.25 T, 0.010 above), sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 2.4 s (8 tau); ends at 10 T · **ETA ~08:44** (≈3h15m)

**Why this fan.** Run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹²) shows tones at 7.5 / 14.9 / 22.3 / 29.9 T against F_L = 33.1 T. Three readings fit that one density: a harmonic comb of 7.5 T; an ABAB pair (7.5 + 22.3 = 29.8) plus a sum/breakdown tone at a lever-arm scale of ≈ 0.90; or an ABCA singleton at 29.9 T plus a 7.5 T comb. The density dependence separates them (Steps 4–5 of the investigation). A harmonic tracks k·f₁ exactly. The ABAB heavy/light ratio drifts from 3.5 (n = 3.2) to 4.8 (n = 2.0) (model). An ABCA singleton has F ∝ n with no partner, and a sum tone equals f₁ + f₂ in every column. The electron side is the only side that reaches design density: the hole side of D = 0 stops at −1.27×10¹², and run 7 there sits in the near-CNP exception regime.

**Design (floored, per recipe step 1).**
- **n window:** [2.0, 3.2]. The top is 16 mV under the TG limit. Below 2.0 the ABAB partner (< 3.2 T) can't be resolved and the heavy tone mimics a singleton (investigation Step 2).
- **B_lo = 0.70 T.** `sdh_onset` on run 6's 10 mT record finds the light tone censored, still above threshold at 1.0 T. Scaling from the 22.3 T tone's measured SNR-vs-B, which follows LK-thermal damping at T_e ≈ 8 K, gives SNR ≈ 15 for m* ≈ 0.027 at 0.7 T. B_lo = 0.7 gives the partner ≥ 5 periods down to n ≈ 2.2; B_lo = 1.0 would stop that at 2.8.
- **Two uniform-1/B segments.** Below 1.25 T, Δ(1/B) = 0.030: only the light tone is alive there (run 6 heavy-tone onsets are 1.40 and 1.76 T), and it gets 3.9 points per period. Above 1.25 T, Δ(1/B) = 0.010, which gives 3.0 points per period at F_L(3.2) and 2.7 at region B's F_L (n + 0.43). This matches the spot check's Δ(1/B).
- **δF:** 1.6 T for the heavy tone and 0.75 T for the light tone. The heavy-vs-F_L gap is 3.2–7.3 T across the window.
- **n-axis sampling:** Δn = 0.050, sized to each tone's own period along n (B / (dF/dn)) at that tone's onset. That gives 3.4 points per period for F_L-slope components at 1.76 T, 3.8 for the heavy tone and 4.5 for the light tone. The recipe's total-ray check at B_lo would call for Δn 0.034 (+12 columns, +40 min), but it guards components that are dead below 1.25 T.
- **B_max = 10 T** buys three things: the ν-ray (Středa) ladder, a scale-free lever-arm pin and 4L-vs-3L check that is independent of the FFT read; the high-B half for the F_L-tone-origin split; and a start point for the LK series to ride down.
- **Acquisition,** inherited from runs 6/7: sr1 at 50 µV, a 5 kΩ full scale. The worst corner (n = 2.0, 10 T) is estimated at ≤ 1.5 kΩ. The state0 replay left sr1 at the 2 µV bring-up value; the cell sets 50 µV. τ is 0.3 s at 24 dB/oct, with fast_delay 2.4 s (8τ, 4 % step residual).

**Coverage trade.** Excluded: the hole side (validator-limited) and n < 2.0 (unresolvable by design). Extending down to n = 1.5 would cost about +40 min for heavy-tone curvature only.

**Checkpoints.**
1. **First rows (0.70 T):** R range vs full scale, drain current ≈ 9.9 nA, gate currents ≪ 1 nA, T_sample.
2. **B ≈ 1.25 T (+35 min):** check the n = 3.2 column against run 6 at the same (n, D). This is a free grid-change reproduction.
3. **B ≈ 2.5 T (~+1 h 30 m):** interim per-column FFT of the light tone, giving f₁(n) (comb vs pair).
4. **B ≈ 5 T (~+2 h 15 m):** FFT over the full claim window.

**Abort** on any of: sustained rail, leak trip, T_sample > 1.6 K, lost drain current, or an n = 3.2 column that disagrees with run 6. The field is left at 10 T.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`, Step 4 of tetralayer-stacking-fs-count): D = 0, n +3.2 -> +2.0e12 (25 pts) x B 0.70 -> 10.0 T (92 rows, uniform-1/B, 2 segments) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration, run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration: ratio data-calibrated, c_tg = geometry prior, D_offset from R_CNP(D) symmetry)
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_HI, N_LO, N_N, D0 = 3.2, 2.0, 25, 0.0                      # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm; dn = 0.050
ns = np.linspace(N_HI, N_LO, N_N)
Vtgs, Vbgs = (np.asarray(v, float) for v in calc_gate_voltages(ns, D0 * np.ones_like(ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"]))
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs, Vbgs)
_n_rt, _D_rt = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(_n_rt, ns, atol=1e-6) and np.allclose(_D_rt, D0, atol=1e-6)
print(f"fast: n {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({N_N} pts), D = {D0}; Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V")

# --- slow: uniform in 1/B, ascending. 0.70-1.25 T at d(1/B) = 0.030 (only the ~7.5 T light tone is alive there: 3.9 pts/period incl. region B x1.13);
#     1.25-10 T at d(1/B) = 0.010 (3.0 pts/period at F_L(3.2) = 33 T; 2.7 at region B's F_L). Magnet sits at 0 T -> starts low, ends at 10 T.
_inv = np.hstack((np.linspace(1 / 0.70, 1 / 1.25, 22)[:-1], np.linspace(1 / 1.25, 1 / 10.0, 71)))
B_vec = np.minimum(np.round(1 / _inv, 4), B_SESSION_CAP)
assert len(B_vec) == 92 and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows (21 coarse + 71 fine); largest step {np.diff(B_vec).max():.3f} T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv0, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_sr_rng, _vap_rng = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {_Tv0:.3f} K (<1.6), heater ranges {_sr_rng}/{_vap_rng} (0/0), "
      f"B = {_B0:+.4f} T (<= {B_vec[0]} T: ascending from where it sits), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()} / output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
print(f"precondition drive sr1 {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz (1.0 V, 13.777 -> 10 nA), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB (0.3 / 24: dwell basis), "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V (0.02)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and _Tv0 < 1.6 and _sr_rng == 0 and _vap_rng == 0
assert -0.05 < _B0 <= B_vec[0] + 0.02
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01 and magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-3 and abs(sr1.frequency() - 13.777) < 0.01
assert sr1.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24 and sr0.sensitivity() == 0.02

# --- acquisition settings inherited from the spot checks (runs 6/7) ---
SENS = 50e-6                                   # 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA; run 6 peak 530 Ohm, worst corner (n 2.0, 10 T) est. <= 1.5 kOhm
sr1.sensitivity(SENS)                          # (state0 replay at handoff left sr1 at the 2 uV bring-up value)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.4, 3.0              # 8 tau at 24 dB/oct (4 % step residual); slow_delay after the row flyback
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (FS {sr1.sensitivity()/10e-9:.0f} Ohm), fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti D = 0: n {N_HI:+.2f} -> {N_LO:+.2f}e12 ({N_N}) x B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows, uniform 1/B: "
                  f"0.030 below 1.25 T, 0.010 above); sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 2.4 s (8 tau); cal run 5")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0} V/nm, n = {N_LO} to {N_HI} (1e12 cm^-2, {N_N} pts, fast high->low), B = {B_vec[0]} to {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows, '
              f'uniform-1/B: d(1/B) 0.030 for 0.70-1.25 T, 0.010 for 1.25-10 T); tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4, electron side; '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'inherits runs 6/7: sr1 50 uV, tau 0.3 s/24 dB')

magnet.field(B_vec[0])                         # blocking ramp 0 -> 0.70 T (~5 min) = the settle (VTI variant step 4)
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

_rail = {"n": 0}
def guards(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if abs(float(data[9])) > 0.95 * SENS:        # clipping is unrecoverable for the FFT: log it, the checkpoint decides
        _rail["n"] += 1
        if _rail["n"] in (1, 10, 100):
            print(f"RAIL #{_rail['n']}: sr1 X = {float(data[9]):.3e} V at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}")
s.register_run_after(guards, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    # field stays where the fan ended (10 T if complete) — the LK mass split rides it down; never re-traverse.
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T_sample {T_sample():.3f} K, rails {_rail['n']}")

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing.
